newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Debonair to trade on EASDAQ late July.
newsitem.headline: Debonair to trade on EASDAQ late July.

text.p: The EASDAQ Market Authority has approved an application for admission to trading on EASDAQ of ordinary shares of British-based airline group Debonair Holdings Plc.

EASDAQ said in a statement on Friday Debonair was to be sponsored by Credit Lyonnais. An indicative number of five million shares is expected to be offered. The company's shares are expected to trade on EASDAQ from late July.
Debonair, started in June 1996, currently operates six BAE 146-200 aircraft, with the seventh entering into service in August. Three more aircraft are due to enter service by the spring of 1998.
